intro.text: Baron Shuden, a JinDo merchant noble and one of Raoden's allies among the powerful lords of Arelon.

items.text: Shuden escorted Sarene to a party at Duke Telrii's, telling her of Shu-Keseg, the parent religion of Shu-Korath and Shu-Dereth, and sharing his concern about Hrathen.
He impressed the group with a ChayShan exercise, though he claimed to be only an amateur.
Shuden was the only noble who agreed to go with Sarene to bring food to the Elantrians, and he went into Elantris with her.
He suggested that Sarene marry Duke Roial, combining their wealth to back Roial's claim to the throne over Telrii's.
Caught by the Derethi with Lukel, Shuden fought back with ChayShan and broke the bones of a Dakhor monk, but they were overwhelmed.
